rival_reading: The field road may reflect routine farm access, and the notice may describe a later closure; an unsent card and stock tally do not establish a failed response.
gloss: A route change and a later public notice remain beside an unsent personal message.
title: Road notice follows the route change
body: The field road on the map is struck through beside a date earlier than the public notice. A postcard home remains unsent; the shop tally counts returned copies, not customers who left.

rival_reading: An early field note could be routine planning, while a later warning could be part of a containment response; the date alone does not settle the cause.
gloss: A field note predates a local warning while the shop records copies rather than readers.
title: Field note predates the notice
body: A field note is dated before the local warning appeared. Someone underlined the weather column for a child; the shop tally records paper counts, not who needed warning.
